title: Bix Caleen
subtitle: Rebel
description: Bix Caleen survived on her wits alone on the distant planet of Ferrix during the time of the Empire. As the owner of a small business pulling technological detritus and scraps, she made money selling the junk parts to anyone who could pay. Fearlessand bold, she was not above taking risks to steal the right parts and sell them to the right buyer, even if it put her on the wrong side of the Empire.
